derivation:
by
  letI := TopologicalSpace.secondCountableTopology_induced (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) E)ᵐᵒᵖ (Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E) MulOpposite.unop
  exact TopologicalSpace.secondCountableTopology_induced G ((Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E) × (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) E)ᵐᵒᵖ) (Units.embedProduct _)
explanation: Apply the induced-topology theorem twice: first to the opposite matrix space, then to the units embedding defining GL's topology. Matrix topology is definitionally the finite function-space topology. The current proof uses embedding-based wrappers instead.
